text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, Bakushin O! A great
responsibility lies
on our shoulders
today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I fully understand! A number of
unauthorized
books have been
reportedly spotted in the school
library,
and it's up to us class representatives to

investigate!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Completely on the mark! It's our call to
decide
whether those books infringe on
academy rules!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Now, first up is this book. It's a horror titled, Evil's Banquet. Oh, there's a tagline, "Satanic one-liners to put you in shivers! On sacrificial sale now!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let me see... "Satan is sent to hell for the
grave
sin of getting too wild at the bar.
Disgruntled at
this unreasonable
sentence, he puts a curse on
the land of
the living."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
There, we meet our tale's protagonist, a
man who
has cheated on his wife. But
when the truth is
revealed, she hires an
assassin for revenge.
Meanwhile, thirteen
messengers born from Satan's
curse
perform a series of ghastly acts...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gah! Reading this nonsense will do
nothing but
rot your brain! I'll let the
disciplinary committee
take care of this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...No! As class representative, I think this
book
should stay!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: What?! Why?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
While I don't understand all the details...
I sense
something very Bakushin about
this book!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
For instance, in the scene where the
protagonist
and his wife are trying to
escape the zombie
army, their car
engine gives out, and they're

unfortunately forced to run three-legged
because
a snake is tied around their
legs!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And how single-mindedly steadfast
Satan clings
to his sense of humor,
cracking joke after joke at
Bakushin
speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's all so Bakushin! Considering the book as a whole, I believe it's valuable material for conveying Bakushin spirit!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... Maybe there's some hidden
passion
between the lines of its story,
but... I find it too
strange to be left on
school grounds.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Like you say, there may be some
problematic
elements in the story!
However, I think this book
can act as a
teaching aid, warning students not to

play pranks!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Think of the various takeaways students
could
obtain through reading this story...
Don't you
think that makes for great
education?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, I see. You're always so insightful,
Bakushin
O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha! You flatter me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: We'll keep this book, for now! The next one up for consideration is, 666 Legends: Reckless Romance at the End of the World.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Too much eavesdropping and I'll
probably give
myself a headache. I
better leave while I can...
